title: docs: retire the npm 10 edgesOut notes on Getting Started, Troubleshooting and Self-hosting
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_
Fixes #29086
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么:官网三页撤下「npm 10 装不了 CLI、必须先升级 npm」的旧提示——Getting Started 删掉警告框;Troubleshooting 的 edgesOut 条目保留(另两页仍链到它),改写为「上游已修复,若仍遇到再用这两个办法」;Self-hosting 裸机步骤不再先装 npm 11,Dockerfile 示例只改注释。
- 为什么改:Troubleshooting 页自己写的撤除条件现已成立(`@vitest/browser-webdriverio` 4.1.12 已发布,npm 10.9.9 能装 18.2.0 的 CLI 和 plugin-auth),旧提示让每个 Node 22 新手做一次多余的全局 npm 升级。
- 风险与回滚:仅三页文档,不发布任何包;若 npm 10 再次出问题,Troubleshooting 条目与锚点仍在;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`content/docs/deployment/troubleshooting.mdx` 的 Cause 段(新的实测陈述),其次 `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` 的 Dockerfile 注释与裸机安装段。
- 两分钟验证:在 Node 22 自带的 npm 10 下运行 `npm install -g @objectstack/cli --dry-run`,预期退出码 0、输出中没有 `edgesOut`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Three docs pages, `+8 / -21`. The removal condition the Troubleshooting entry set for these notes was re-measured at PR time and holds (readings below).

1. **`content/docs/getting-started/index.mdx`** — the Prerequisites `warn` callout ("npm 10 cannot install the CLI right now") is removed. Your First Project (narrowed in PR #29084, left alone here) and Troubleshooting still carry the fallback for anyone who hits the crash.
2. **`content/docs/deployment/troubleshooting.mdx`** — the `edgesOut` entry is **narrowed, not removed**: Your First Project and Self-hosting both link to its anchor, and Your First Project is out of this card's scope, so removing the heading would break a live link. The Cause now says the crash was fixed upstream (4.1.12 published; npm 10.9.9 installs CLI and plugin-auth 18.2.0); the Fix reads "if you still hit it" and keeps both remedies unchanged, including the GHSA-qxg6-89mg-rqv8 advice to move a `~4.0.0` vitest pin to `~4.1.12`, which stands on its own. The removal-condition paragraph is deleted, since its condition is met.
3. **`content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`**
   - Bare Node (systemd): no more "install with npm 11" paragraph and no `npm install -g npm@11` line; one sentence says Node 22's npm installs the CLI and links Troubleshooting for the crash.
   - Self-built runtime Dockerfile: **the install line is kept byte-for-byte**, because the sample is presented as the equivalent of the real `docker/Dockerfile`, which still installs under a pinned npm 11 (`"npm@11.21.0"`). Only its two-line comment changes: it no longer says npm 10 fails, and says the sample installs under npm 11 as the official image does.

| Claim | Backed by |
|:---|:---|
| `npm view vitest dist-tags` lists `V4: 4.1.12` | measured at PR time (below) |
| `@vitest/browser-webdriverio` 4.1.12 is published and matches vitest 4.1.12 | `npm view @vitest/browser-webdriverio versions` contains `4.1.12` (published 2026-10-30T04:03Z); its `peerDependencies.vitest` is `^4.1.12` |
| npm 10.9.9 installs `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/plugin-auth` 18.2.0, globally and into a project | the three dry-run installs below, exit 0, zero `edgesOut` lines |
| The self-built Dockerfile sample installs under npm 11 as the official image does | `docker/Dockerfile` `RUN npm install --prefix /tmp/os-installer-npm ... "npm@11.21.0"` block, same lines as the sample |
| `node:22-slim`'s npm 10 installs the CLI | `docker/Dockerfile` header comment records node:22-slim bundling npm 10.9.9; the global dry-run below is on npm 10.9.9 (not re-run inside the image) |
| Your First Project and Self-hosting link the Troubleshooting anchor | `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx` line 42; `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` bare-Node paragraph |

## Tests

Docs-only diff, no package touched, so no build closure or package test is owed. The gate families `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for these paths were all run on the final head (Verification).

## Acceptance notes

- PM assumption refuted, on purpose: a full removal of the Troubleshooting entry would leave `your-first-project.mdx` (out of scope) pointing at a dead anchor, so the entry is narrowed and keeps its heading. `check:doc-anchors` confirms all 854 fragment links resolve.
- `docker/Dockerfile` still installs under a pinned npm 11, and its header comment still says npm 10 crashes on this install. That is no longer true, but the file works and is not on this card's surface; changing the image build is a separate decision. The docs sample mirrors it as-is.
- Left alone, as the card says: the pnpm-project `npm install --save-dev` note in `ai/skills.mdx`, `ai/skills-reference.mdx` (and its twin in `upgrading.mdx`) — a different failure.
- No changeset: `content/docs/` ships in no package's `files[]` (`git grep '"content' -- packages/*/package.json` → 0 hits); label `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Removal-condition readings — Node v22.23.4, npm 10.9.9, 2026-11-02</summary>

- `npm view vitest dist-tags` → `V3: 3.2.7`, `V4: 4.1.12`, `latest: 5.0.5`, `rc: 5.0.0-rc.4`, `beta: 5.1.0-beta.1`.
- `npm view @vitest/browser-webdriverio versions` → contains `4.1.12`; `time` 4.1.11 2026-08-18, 4.1.12 2026-10-30; `@4.1.12 peerDependencies` → `vitest ^4.1.12`, `webdriverio *`.
- Newest published: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` and `@objectstack/cli` `latest` = `next` = `18.2.0`.
- `npm install --dry-run @objectstack/plugin-auth@18.2.0` into an empty project → exit 0, `added 273 packages`, 0 `edgesOut` lines.
- `npm install --dry-run @objectstack/cli@18.2.0` into an empty project → exit 0, `added 523 packages`, 0 `edgesOut` lines.
- `npm install -g --prefix SCRATCH --dry-run @objectstack/cli@18.2.0 "pg@^8.0.0" "mysql2@^3.0.0"` (the image's install set) → exit 0, `added 549 packages`, 0 `edgesOut` lines. A first attempt exited 254 with `ENOENT lstat` on the not-yet-created prefix directory; re-run after creating it.

</details>

<details><summary>Gate run on 7fc5f1a696 — 44 derived, 44 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE` → `Run reconciliation — 44 derived, 44 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (exit 0; all 44 recorded exit 0). Five gates first exited on prerequisites (`check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift` with exit 3; `@objectstack/spec check:docs` with exit 1 on an unbuilt `packages/spec/dist`) and were re-run green after building the `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/client-react` closures and `@objectstack/spec` under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). Key lines: `check-doc-anchors: 854 internal #fragment link(s) across 481 source file(s) all resolve to a real heading`; `check-docs-image-tag: OK (3/3 enumerated surface(s) read, 9 concrete pin(s) compared ...)`; `check-docs-redirects: OK`; `check-nul-bytes: OK`. Not measured locally (CI only): the Build Docs job and the type-check lanes.

</details>
